curriculum.name: Montessori & Practical Life Inquiry
curriculum.tagline: Child-centered, hands-on self-discovery and practical life mastery
curriculum.description: Rooted in Maria Montessori pedagogical principles with prepared environments, sensorial exploration, and practical life independence.

term_package.title: Montessori Primary - Term 1 Prepared Environment Box
term_package.subtitle: Practical Life, Sensorial, Language Phonics, Golden Beads Math & Cultural Studies
features: 12 Prepared Environment Weekly Guides with Material Recipes
Practical Life Pouring, Spooning, Sweeping & Buttoning Frames
Sensorial Pink Tower, Broad Stair & Color Tablets at Home
Golden Beads Decimal System & Sandpaper Letters

weeks.sub_strand: Dry Pouring, Walking the Line & Sandpaper Letters /m/, /s/
learning_outcomes: Walk the line with balanced posture
Trace sandpaper letters using two fingers

lessons.subject: Montessori Practical Life
lessons.topic: Dry Pouring from Pitcher to Pitcher
lessons.parent_script: Observe in quiet concentration: Watch how I hold the pitcher by the handle and support the base.
lessons.learning_objective: Pour dried beans from one small glass pitcher into another without spilling a single bean.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Present dry pouring in 3 distinct steps in silence.
2. Invite child to repeat the exercise independently.
3. Clean up tray if any beans fall.

lessons.subject: Sensorial Materials
lessons.topic: Visual Discrimination of Size: DIY Stacking Bowls
lessons.parent_script: Feel the edges of each block. Which one is thickest? Which one is thinnest?
lessons.learning_objective: Gradate 5 objects in sequence from thickest to thinnest.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Unroll work rug with two hands.
2. Arrange nesting bowls randomly, then sort in order.
3. Verify sequence with finger test.

lessons.subject: Language: Sandpaper Letters
lessons.parent_script: Period 1: This is /m/. Period 2: Show me /m/. Period 3: What is this?
lessons.learning_objective: Trace sandpaper letter in the direction of writing while vocalizing its phonetic sound.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Trace letter with index and middle finger.
2. Speak the pure phonetic sound.
3. Trace the same sound in the cornmeal tray.
